voice_notes.transcript: ok derek osei, pinnacle rehab, mississauga. six locations. each place has its own google calendar and head office rolls it into one big sheet on fridays. operations guy. first thing he needs is the security write-up for their IT department. solid.

sophie trembly, gatineau, massage, just her and two others I think. she's on pract shift and they started charging her per text reminder this summer and she's pretty mad about it. didn't ask for anything really. french speaker, nadia should maybe write to her.

jen, bayview in moncton, three clinics, on bookstead. twice in august bookstead double booked her saturday massage therapists, she was livid. she'd like a demo with her clinic managers in the room. ravi her co-owner was there, finance guy, he asked what we charge per practitioner, fourteen across the three.

gord pottie, sydney cape breton, sports physio, single clinic, paper. his front desk person is buried in phone bookings. he doesn't want a demo, he wants her to get a trial login and mess around with it. told him we'd sort that.

amira haddad, still waters, halifax, massage. three RMTs on a shared google calendar, bookings keep getting overwritten. she asked for the price. and she was firm, no newsletter, no list, pricing and that's it. no card, scanned her.
grace whitford, ottawa, two massage clinics. pracshift logs her therapists out mid-day. not looking to switch yet, just irritated. her father is in hospital in kingston, leave that alone.

nadia just told me about one she had in french, a physio from shediac, ellen or helen arsenault, on clean evo, her contract renews at the end of the year and nadia told her we'd call her after thanksgiving. nadia has her card. putting it here so we don't lose it.

duncan ferris, charlottetown, physio, one clinic, on clinivo. what he really wants is for clients to grab the last minute cancellation slots online instead of his front desk phoning down a list. nice chat. didn't ask for anything.
liam, massage therapist, fredericton, the tall one. paper, works alone. not ready, said maybe next year. nothing to send.
peggy from riverside massage, fredericton too. office manager. she wants something she can show the owner, so send her the brochure or the one pager. she's not the decision maker.

okay day two. steve from grandview, five sites, kitchener waterloo. on pract shift. his renewal is at the end of the year and he wants to compare before then, so demo asap. he's the guy with the bow tie. he said he'll bring his ops lead.
shauna, st john's, seawall massage. one location today, second one opening in mount pearl next month, paper book. she said ring her after the new place opens, not before.
dan pothier, atlantic motion, halifax and bedford, three clinics, clinivo. he can't pull a report out of it, hates that. demo please.

patrick from bathurst, doucet physio, he went to dal with sam, small world. he ditched book stead in april and he's running the whole clinic off a spreadsheet now. wants a demo but not till he's back from vacation, he's back on the fifth.

correction on jen from bayview from yesterday, she came back by, she said monday the twenty eighth works for the demo, mornings, and to copy her ops manager. so demo with managers, week of the twenty eighth.
yvonne clarke, saint john, one clinic, paper book. straight up said get me a demo booked. tired of being on the phone all day.
scanner's still dead. farah from westdale massage in hamilton, google calendar, she wants to try it with her two RMTs first before she shows anyone. so set her up with a trial. got her card.
tyler brennan, brennan and ward physio, oakville, two clinics, bookstead. needs the pricing written down for his business partner. have his card, scanner's dead.
mei lin zhou, markham, acupuncture and massage, one clinic, clinivo. would like a demo. wondered if reminders could be sent in mandarin. said I'd find out.
ben kowalczyk, northline, ottawa, four clinics, all four front desks on paper. he manages, doesn't own. wants something to put in front of the owner.
lucie from dieppe, massage, paper, we mostly talked about her kids' hockey. nothing there really. nadia has her card.
okay wrap up. talked to a lot of people. scanner died for about an hour after lunch today so the cards from then are in my bag. nadia has some cards too. I'll do a list on the plane.
